items.label: Chat fade / needs Settings
items.discord_line: Chat fades or you can turn that on in Settings.

items.label: Double craft after respawn
items.skip_rule: Skip if no forge on the live channel under test.
items.discord_line: After respawn, craft the same recipe twice when you have materials for two. Both outputs stay and both crafts show in server log. Skip if this live channel has no forge.

items.label: Door Discord apply wording
items.discord_line: Unaccepted Discord account gets the apply message and a usable Discord invite open action.

items.label: Interim launcher speaking light
items.discord_line: Launcher shows the interim speaking light (not the voice head mark).

items.label: Purse once, player trade, fail-loud mint
items.discord_line: Starting purse is 40 gold once per character. Player trade moves pack gold. Second mint or phantom craft gold fails loud. Do not test trader stock.

items.label: Server craft gate refuse reason
items.discord_line: A refused craft keeps materials and shows a clear server reason. Do not Pass recipe visibility without the perk.

items.label: K panel profession / half main path
items.discord_line: K panel shows profession and half for a current-rulebook character on the main path.
